ios.desc:
Track Goals. Build Habits. Stay Consistent.
Goal Tracker Pro is a powerful goal tracker and habit tracker designed to help you stay consistent, build routines, and make real progress every day.

Struggling to stay consistent with your goals? Losing motivation after a few days? This daily planner and routine tracker keeps your progress visible so you stay focused and never fall off track.
With a simple system and instant feedback, Goal Tracker Pro turns your goals into clear, daily actions you can actually stick to.


WHY GOAL TRACKER PRO WORKS

Built for consistency, not complexity.
-Goal Tracker + Habit Tracker in One 
Track daily habits, long-term goals, and routines in one clean system. No switching between apps.
-Tap-to-Progress (Feel Every Win) 
Log progress instantly with a unique tap system and haptic feedback. Every action feels rewarding.
-Visual Progress That Motivates You 
See exactly how close you are to your goals with simple, color-coded progress bars.
-Simple Daily Planner 
Plan your day in seconds. Stay focused on what actually matters.
-Habit Streak Tracker 
Build momentum with streaks and stay consistent over time.
-Minimalist & Distraction-Free 
No clutter. No ads. Just a clean productivity tool built for focus.


ONE APP. ALL YOUR GOALS.
Use Goal Tracker Pro as your:
-Habit Tracker – build daily routines that stick 
-Goal Tracker – track long-term progress 
-Daily Planner – organize your day clearly
-Routine Tracker – stay consistent effortlessly


REAL USE CASES
-Fitness & Health 
-Track workouts, weight loss, or daily habits like drinking water.
-Finance & Savings 
-Set savings goals and track your progress step by step.
-Career & Productivity 
-Break big goals into small tasks and stay consistent daily.
-Personal Growth 
-Build habits like reading, meditation, or learning new skills.


START SIMPLE: THE 4-GOAL SYSTEM
-Start free with up to 4 active goals.
-Focus on what matters most without feeling overwhelmed.
-Ready for more? Unlock unlimited goals and take full control of your progress.


STOP PROCRASTINATING. START TRACKING.
Consistency beats motivation.
This app helps you show up every day.
Download Goal Tracker Pro and start building habits that actually last.


PREMIUM FEATURES
Use Goal Tracker Pro for free with up to 4 goals.
Upgrade for unlimited access:
-Lifetime Access – one-time purchase 
-Monthly Subscription
-Yearly Plan (Best Value)
Subscriptions renew automatically. Pricing may vary by region.
